schemaPolicy: Unknown required source / processing schemas fail explicit verification. sourceJob is optional; when absent, complete actual receipt and generation evidence suffice. Optional delivery metadata is separately marked observed-at-audit and semantically matched to the SHA-bound PNG, never claimed historically hash-bound. Archive-dependent guides and recorded QA are reconstructed from exact archived pixels.
